text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Thank you for
giving me
time to rest.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I do. I was worried about falling behind,
so I did
some light exercise to maintain
my condition.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
As it's said, in times of peace, prepare
for strife.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's important to make good use of your
time
off. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Грасс Вандер has
remained vigilant
even on her day off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
